name: Borja Giménez Larraz - § 14 - Am 69
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 14. Believes that, in zones of housing stress, land already designated for residential housing development should be exclusively allocated to social and affordable housing in order to prevent speculative use and ensure structural long-term affordability; underlines that Member States should be encouraged to develop clear, time-bound and legally secure instruments to enable the temporary community use for community benefit functions of underused or neglected land and premises, including assets held by municipalities and private owners, where these are left vacant without credible plans for timely reactivation, for social and affordable housing formats, in particular modular solutions; highlights that various solutions already exist to build new housing without new consumption of natural areas, while, at the same time, improving building quality and increasing housing supply and diversity; underlines that these solutions range from gentle, horizontal and vertical density housing, co-designed with local residents, to urban renewal, including the development of lightweight housing;
